candidates_inspected.head: ad240be4b6ddd030d07d148725c33ca9e4aade74
candidates_inspected.finding: This is the NeuruhAI-owned ResellOS/FSP rebuild identity and was the first-choice existing repository. It is ARCHIVED, which makes it read-only on GitHub: it cannot accept a push without first changing its archived state.
candidates_inspected.rationale: Archiving is a deliberate act by the owner. Un-archiving someone's retired repository in order to push to it is a change to existing Neuruh state that this mission was not asked to make, and the mission's own custody court provides for exactly this case: record the conflict and use the preferred new private repository instead. The repository was inspected read-only and was not modified in any way.

repository_selection.conflict_recorded: NeuruhAI/neuruh-resell-os is archived and therefore not a compatible custody target. It remains archived and unmodified.

custody.note: This receipt file is itself committed after the verification above, so the branch tip advances by exactly one commit when the receipt is pushed. That final commit is verified the same way immediately after its push, and the resulting SHA is recorded in CONTINUATION_CHECKPOINT.json.
